about.heading: About
paragraphs: Hudson Hensley is a young actor working in film and on stage, based between Los Angeles and Nashville. He is known for the energy, emotional directness and natural screen presence he brings to a role. His breakout is the 2025 musical drama Song Sung Blue, written and directed by Craig Brewer, in which he appears alongside Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson.

In Song Sung Blue — a story about music, love and reinvention — Hensley plays Dayna Cartwright, the son of Claire Sardina (Kate Hudson) from her first marriage, a role that places him in a large ensemble opposite Jackman and Hudson. Alongside the film he has the lead role of Scott in the independent feature The Wildman of Shaggy Creek, adapted from a children's book, and has performed on stage with the Nashville Theatre School in Thirteen Jr. and Legally Blonde Jr.
